contracts.declared_mechanism: Default-deny permission configuration: BasePyodideSandbox.__init__ declares allow_env/read/write/net/run/ffi defaulting to False; build_permission_flag omits the flag when the value is False (Deno default deny) and builds allow-lists for non-empty lists; perm_defs force read/write defaults to ["node_modules"] when unset; the assembled self.permissions plus --node-modules-dir are appended via cmd.extend(self.permissions) in _build_command for every 'deno run'; PyodideSandboxTool propagates its allow_* settings into both sandbox instances at tool construction. Reinforcing resource guards: asyncio.wait_for timeout with process.kill on TimeoutError (async) and subprocess.run timeout=timeout_seconds (sync), plus optional --max-old-space-size memory limit.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Sandboxed untrusted code acquiring privileged host access not explicitly allow-listed: environment variable reads, filesystem reads/writes beyond node_modules, network connections, subprocess execution, or FFI access (i.e., any effective --allow-env/--allow-read/--allow-write/--allow-net/--allow-run/--allow-ffi grant beyond configured scope) during 'deno run' execution.
